scenes.vo: Fog in the forecast: the signal is checked. Three steps.

scenes.plate: Step 1. Read the forecast, write the time
scenes.img: Ines at the desk of the harbour office, one hand on the radio set, the other writing a line into an open logbook; the window shows a grey, hazy evening over the pier. Medium shot.
scenes.anim: She finishes the line and looks up at the window.
scenes.vo: The clerk reads the evening forecast off the radio and writes the time into the log. Fog after nine — that is the trigger.

scenes.plate: Step 2. Test the horn — two short, one long
scenes.img: Mara stands at the signal panel in the lantern room with one hand on a large lever; Tomas is beside her, notebook open, watching the panel. Wide shot, the lens behind them catching the last light.
scenes.anim: Mara pulls the lever down once, holds it, lets it back up.
scenes.vo: The keeper tests the horn from the panel: two short blasts, one long. The apprentice counts them and writes what he heard, not what he expected.

scenes.plate: Step 3. Confirm with the harbour by radio
scenes.img: Tomas on the pier at dusk, a handheld radio at his mouth, looking back up at the lighthouse; the lamp above has just come on. Medium shot.
scenes.anim: He lowers the radio and gives a small thumbs-up towards the tower.
scenes.vo: Then somebody outside confirms it was heard. The apprentice calls the office from the pier; the clerk answers and logs the time. Now the check is done.
Forecast. Horn. Radio. Three lines in the log, and the night can come in.

scenes.vo: Every morning, in the same order. Three steps.

scenes.img: Ines switches on the radio set with one hand and opens the logbook to a fresh page with the other; morning light through the window. Medium shot.
scenes.anim: She turns the dial, then flattens the page.
scenes.vo: The radio goes on before anything else, and the log is opened at the day's page. Whatever happens next gets a line.

scenes.plate: Step 2. Walk the pier, count the boats
scenes.img: Tomas walking along the pier in the morning, notebook in hand, looking at the moored boats; the lighthouse behind him with its lamp off. Wide shot.
scenes.anim: A slow walk along the pier, two steps.
scenes.vo: The apprentice walks the pier and counts what is tied up. The number goes in the log next to yesterday's.

scenes.img: Tomas at the office door with his notebook; Mara at the desk, looking up from the log with a mug in her hand. Medium shot, both in frame.
scenes.anim: Tomas holds up the notebook; Mara nods once.
scenes.vo: Then the count goes to the keeper, out loud, and she writes it down herself. Two people, one number, no surprises.
Radio. Pier. Keeper. The office is open.
